prompt: Three of the same small rectangles are put together to make a big rectangle, as shown. The big rectangle is 10 inches tall. How many inches wide is it?

solutions.title: Short side is half the long side
solutions.body:
The left rectangle stands upright, so its long side is the 10-inch height. On the right, two rectangles are stacked, so two short sides equal one long side: the short side is 5 inches. Width $=$ short side of the upright rectangle $+$ long side of a lying rectangle $= 5 + 10 = 15$ inches.

**Answer: 15 inches**

solutions.title: Area check
solutions.body:
Each small rectangle is $5 \times 10 = 50$ in², so the big rectangle has area $150$ in². With height 10, the width is $150 \div 10 = 15$ inches.

**Answer: 15 inches**

prompt:
What is the largest **odd** sum you can get by adding four of the numbers below?

$$4 \quad 5 \quad 7 \quad 9 \quad 10 \quad 11 \quad 12$$

solutions.title: One odd or three odd
solutions.body:
An odd sum of four numbers needs an odd count of odd numbers: 1 or 3.
- 1 odd + 3 even: $11 + 12 + 10 + 4 = 37$.
- 3 odd + 1 even: $11 + 9 + 7 + 12 = 39$.

The largest is **39**.

**Answer: 39**

solutions.title: Start from the biggest sum
solutions.body:
The four biggest numbers $12 + 11 + 10 + 9 = 42$ is even. To make it odd, swap one number for one of the other parity, losing as little as possible: swap 10 for 7 (lose 3) to get 39; other swaps (9→4, lose 5; 12→7, lose 5; …) lose more.

**Answer: 39**

prompt: Alex glues four cubes together to make this shape. How many square cube faces are on the outside of this shape, including the three on the bottom?

solutions.title: Count each cube
solutions.body:
Looking cube by cube, the three cubes that touch only one other cube each show 5 faces, and the bottom-front cube that touches the other three shows 3 faces: $5 + 5 + 5 + 3 = 18$.

**Answer: 18**

solutions.title: Subtract hidden faces
solutions.body:
Four cubes have $4 \times 6 = 24$ faces. The shape has 3 places where two cubes are glued, and each hides 2 faces: $24 - 3 \times 2 = 18$.

**Answer: 18**
